scripts.clean:dev: for port in 3001 5173; do dnh_pids=$(lsof -ti tcp:$port -sTCP:LISTEN); [ -z "$dnh_pids" ] || kill $dnh_pids; done
scripts.dev: npm run clean:dev && concurrently "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.test: npm run test -w backend && npm run test -w frontend
